newsitem.title: USA: Legato expands pact with Siemens Nixdorf.
newsitem.headline: Legato expands pact with Siemens Nixdorf.

text.p: Legato Systems Inc on Monday said it expanded a licensing agreement with Siemens Nixdorf Information Services.

The expanded source-code agreement allows Siemens Nixdorf to license Legato's NetWorker for the Windows NT operating system. The original agreement, set in 1993, licensed NetWorker for UNIX operating systems.
Under the agreement, Siemens Nixdorf, a unit of German-based Siemens AG, will sell the NetWorker product to its worldwide customers and can make licensing agreements with its own customers.
Shares of Legato were 4-1/4 higher at 32-3/4 in late trading on the Nasdaq.
